results.title: Build Agents, Automate Workflows, and Unlock Your Content—All in One Platform - Egnyte Blog
results.content:
Without Agent Builder, an investment analyst spends up to 8 hours synthesizing a 200-page CIM into a deal memo, and deploys a CIM Analysis Agent trained on internal templates. Agent Builder cuts that time significantly, producing a structured draft in minutes. AI Safeguards can lock the content to deal-room content only. Analyst time shifts from synthesis to judgment.

A general contractor managing 500 subcontractor agreements can run Bulk Extraction across all of them in minutes. Every contract is tagged with renewal dates, liability caps, and payment terms that are searchable, AI-ready, and access-controlled. Project managers stop chasing documents and start making decisions.

Image removed.

## Agent Marketplace: Pre-Built Agents for You or Your Industry [...] Most AI initiatives that involve agents stall because building effective agents has looked like a developer’s job. All-new Agent Builder changes that: Describe what you need in plain English and go. Pick your data sources, wire up recommended connectors, and configure everything through an easy-to-follow setup that anyone can tackle. The person who knows the workflow builds the agent. No explaining it to engineering.

For more advanced AI adopters, agents can also be built by uploading skill files from the AI tools your team already uses. Every agent operates within your existing permission model, for example: [...] New conditional logic brings additional power to workflows, and now, agents can be part of the flow as well. Any agent in your library can be invoked directly inside a workflow, or you can run a prompt against your content. For example, a project manager uploads a submittal. A workflow fires instantly, extracting metadata, routing by trade type, flagging spec conflicts, triggering approval, and filing the result automatically. What used to take two days of email chains and multiple manual reminders is now run automatically.

Image removed.

results.title: CrewAI Alternatives: 8 Agent Frameworks for Production Workflows - ZenML Blog
results.content:
It provides the plumbing to manage your agents’ lifecycle, from deployment to monitoring to evaluation. In practical terms, ZenML fills the gaps around agent frameworks.

Here are a few ways our platform helps close the outer loop:

### 1. End-to-End Orchestration

 ZenML architecture diagram for orchestrating AI workflows 

ZenML architecture

 

ZenML allows you to embed your agent as one step in a larger pipeline.

For example, a ZenML pipeline might preprocess incoming data, then call your AI agent, then post-process or store the results. These pipelines are portable across environments – you can run them on a local machine for testing, then schedule them on Kubernetes or a cloud runner for production. [...] Provides a canvas UI where you can drag-and-drop nodes representing components (LLMs, prompts, tools, memory stores, etc.) and connect them to define the flow of information. This visual approach makes it intuitive to map out an agent’s reasoning.
 Comes with a library of pre-built nodes for common tasks (LLMs, web search, database queries, conditional logic, etc.). You can configure each node’s parameters through the UI, saving time since you don’t need to implement these from scratch.
 Lets you iterate visually, adjust prompts and parameters, and run flows through the UI or API. This makes it useful for prototyping, sharing workflows with non-specialists, and turning approved flows into application-facing endpoints. [...] The question is not whether CrewAI can build useful crews. It can. The harder question is whether its abstraction, pricing model, deployment path, state model, observability, and governance fit the way your team wants to run agents in production. If your workflows need strict state control, clean handoffs, human approvals, resumable runs, durable memory, and deployment targets that match your stack, it is worth comparing CrewAI with alternatives that make those trade-offs differently.

We reviewed 8 real alternatives and mapped each one to the CrewAI jobs it can replace, where it wins, and where it falls short.

results.content:
No-code AI agent building extends workflow automation by adding reasoning and autonomy. Traditional automation follows fixed if-then rules, executing only what has been explicitly programmed. AI agents, by contrast, can interpret instructions, decide which actions to take, and complete multi-step workflows independently. They also improve over time by learning from human feedback and real-world outcomes, rather than remaining static.

## Build AI agents without any code with Airtable

As a no-code AI workflow platform, Airtable adapts to your team’s unique processes and workflows. Whether you're managing product launches, coordinating marketing campaigns, or tracking customer operations, Airtable enables you to embed autonomous agents directly into your processes. [...] ### What is a no-code AI agent builder?

A no-code AI agent builder lets non-technical teams create intelligent automations, custom apps, and AI-powered workflows—without writing code. These platforms replace traditional development with visual builders and AI-driven automation, eliminating the need for JavaScript, SQL, or Python.

Business users can build agents that analyze data, generate content, and execute multi-step workflows. The best platforms go a step further by embedding conversational AI, so you can create apps and automations simply by describing what you want—instead of configuring complex rules.

## What to look for in an AI agent builder [...] ## 10 best AI agent builders and tools in 2026

Here are 10 best AI agent builders in 2026, selected for an emphasis on low- or no-code platforms for teams at different skill levels, and businesses of different sizes.

### 1. Airtable - Best for no-code agent building for AI-powered workflows

Airtable is an AI workflow platform where teams can build custom agents that think dynamically across your operations. The platform embeds intelligence directly into your data structures. Field Agents can enrich leads with real-time company data, analyze documents to extract structured information, or generate localized content across hundreds of assets—all without leaving your Airtable workspace.
